message: Hi, I want to buy US stocks, which tariff is better for me?
Hello! This is Daniel from Freedom support. How much do you plan to invest and how often will you trade?
About $2000, a few trades per month
Then the Standard tariff fits: 0.12% + $1.2 per order. You can switch it in the app under Profile > Tariffs.
Is there anything else I can help you with?
Thank you for contacting us, have a great day!
